content: अपाङ्क्त, -पाङ्क्तेय, -पाङ्क्त्य {%a.%} ‘Not in the same row or line’; especially one who is not allowed by his caste-men to sit in the same row with them at meals; degraded, excommunicated, excluded from or inadmissible into society, an outcast; ˚उपहत defiled by the presence of excommunicated or impious persons. एतान्विगर्हिताचारानपाङ्क्तेयान्द्विजाधमान् (विवर्जयेत्) <ls>Ms. 3. 167</ls>.
